step output

  • CURIE: gmeow:stepOutput
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/stepOutput
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/procedures

An entity produced by a procedure step — a derived dataset, claim, event, observation, or artifact. Range is owl:Thing. Non-functional: a step may have multiple outputs, and competing output claims coexist.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:ProcedureStep -> owl:Thing

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:stepOutput from gmeow:ProcedureStep to owl:Thing when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
